paper.abstract_en: In the standard $Λ\rm CDM$ model, the Universe will keep expanding forever and its lifetime is infinite. Therefore, even the heaviest supermassive black hole will eventually evaporate and the universal occurrence of the black hole information paradox is unavoidable. However, the recent DESI results seem to indicate that dark energy is dynamical and, more importantly, it is possible that the Universe has a finite lifetime and will experience a ``Big Crunch" in some billion years from now. In light of this, the lightest confirmed black hole with mass of order one solar mass may not have a chance to evaporate before the Universe ends. Inspired by these observations, we thus raise an intriguing conjecture: Does the Universe choose a configuration such that the ``in-principle" black hole information paradox can never actually happen in reality? We derive a lower bound on black hole mass as a function of the Universe's lifetime such that the information paradox cannot be realized in nature and some resulting predictions are made. Some profound implications for other related big ideas in physics are briefly discussed.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文提出一个关于黑洞信息悖论与宇宙寿命之间关系的猜想，并推导黑洞质量下界，属于引力量子基础与黑洞热力学交叉的概念性研究，值得点击进一步阅读其推导细节。
decision.abstract_zh: 在标准 $\Lambda\rm CDM$ 模型中，宇宙将永远膨胀，其寿命是无限的。因此，即使是最重的超大质量黑洞最终也会蒸发，黑洞信息悖论的普遍发生不可避免。然而，最近的 DESI 结果似乎表明暗能量是动力学性的，更重要的是，宇宙可能具有有限寿命，并将在距今数十亿年后的某个时候经历一次“大坍缩”。有鉴于此，最轻的已确认黑洞（质量约为一个太阳质量）可能没有机会在宇宙终结之前蒸发。受这些观察启发，我们因此提出一个有趣的猜想：宇宙是否选择了一种构型，使得“原则上”的黑洞信息悖论在现实中永远不会实际发生？我们推导出黑洞质量作为宇宙寿命函数的下界，使得信息悖论在自然界中无法实现，并作出了一些由此产生的预测。我们还简要讨论了这对物理学中其他相关宏大思想的一些深刻含义。
